diagnostics.limitation: Passing finite-chain diagnostics cannot exclude unvisited modes or establish model calibration.

definitions.coverage: central componentwise intervals on free-node positions only; pinned nodes excluded

physics.energy_note: Gravity potential included. Drag dissipates and stochastic forcing exchanges energy; total energy need not be constant.
